claims.claim: Direct tokunbo Japan highest grade Rogue and Altima gearbox
claims.evidence: Witness report shows an exposed car transmission/gearbox assembly with wiring/hoses, but no brand/model markings, part number, or compatibility identifiers (no VIN/label/plate visible).
No origin documents, labels, or shipping/auction tags are visible in the witness observations.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show the transmission casing/top cover removed/absent and the unit partially disassembled/opened with internal components visible, plus grime/oil staining—this conflicts with 'never opened' and 'tested/working' being verifiable from the images.

risks.risk: Unknown exact transmission type/variant (manual vs automatic, and which specific Rogue/Altima variant). Wrong fit can make it unusable or require costly swaps.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the transmission identification plate/label (part number, model code) and the vehicle compatibility stamp, plus a shot showing the transmission type markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-verified, potentially wrong-fit gearbox (worst-case compatibility risk), not as a guaranteed Rogue/Altima match.

risks.risk: Completeness and missing parts (covers, sensors, bolts, internal components) since the unit appears opened/partially disassembled.
risks.proof: A full set of photos showing the entire transmission externally (all ports/sensors/holes covered or accounted for) and a close-up inventory of any removed components.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness, assuming missing or unaccounted parts until proven otherwise.

risks.risk: Internal condition (bearings, seals, clutch packs/torque converter condition) cannot be confirmed from exterior/internal glimpses; oil staining may indicate leaks or contamination.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the transmission being run/tested (engagement through gears, reverse, no abnormal noise) and a photo of fluid condition (clean vs burnt/metallic) with dipstick/inspection port.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially worn/possibly leaking/unknown internal health (worst-case), not as 'no knock' working.

risks.risk: Leakage and seal integrity (oil staining and grime around the casing suggest possible leaks).
risks.proof: After-cleaning test: a clip showing the unit running and then a close-up check for fresh leaks around seals/hoses, plus photos of the underside after a short run.
risks.if_unproven: Price as leak-prone/unknown seal condition until leak-free operation is demonstrated.

risks.risk: Electrical/harness and sensor integrity (wiring/hoses are visible; damage or missing connectors can prevent proper operation).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of every connector/port and a continuity/functional test result (or a video showing error-free operation with the harness connected).
risks.if_unproven: Price as electrical/sensor condition unknown, assuming potential faults requiring replacement.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the transmission identification plate/label (part number/model code) and any compatibility markings.
Video proof of testing: engagement through all gears (or forward/reverse for automatic), no abnormal noise, and stable operation.
Photos of fluid condition (inspection port/dipstick) and whether fluid was drained/changed; include a close-up of any metallic debris.
Photos showing completeness: all sensors/ports/covers present and correctly seated; include a checklist of removed parts (if any).
After-test leak check: run briefly, then show close-ups of seals/hoses for fresh oil.
response.reason: The witness report shows the gearbox appears opened/partially disassembled with oil/grime, which directly undermines the seller’s 'never opened' and 'tested and working' claims. Without proof of exact variant/compatibility and functional testing, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
